{{Top|leg}}
'''Chromalloy''' was a material. [[Base Prime]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] operated by the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] businessmen [[Craitheus Qreph|Qreph]] and [[Marvid Qreph]] to study a [[Unidentified monolith|monolith]] of unknown origin, included corridors and other features built from chromalloy.<ref name="Crucible">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>
 
==Behind the scenes==
Chromalloy appeared in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
